Method of Attack: Exploiting Exim mail transfer agent vulnerability CVE-2019-10149 to execute arbitrary commands as root via specially crafted emails
Downloading and installing Watchbog Linux trojan to add infected servers to a Monero cryptomining botnet
Impacted Systems: Linux servers running vulnerable Exim versions
Attack Vector: Sending commands in the 'MAIL FROM' field of SMTP messages to vulnerable Exim MTAs
Indicators of Compromise: script1.sh shell script used by Sandworm to add privileged users, import SSH keys, execute base64 encoded commands, and restart sshd and MySQL daemons
Attacker-controlled domains hosting malicious shell scripts
